# Isaiah Chapter 65 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 159v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_065_page_001.jpg

---

**65:17** "For behold, I [am] creating [borei] new [chadashim] heavens [shamayim] and-a-new [chadashah] earth [arets]; and-the-former-things [ha-rishonot] will-not be-remembered [lo tizzakharnah] and-will-not come [lo ta'alenah] upon the-heart [al-lev]."

**65:25** "The-wolf [ze'ev] and-the-lamb [taleh] will-graze [yir'u] as-one [ke-echad], and-the-lion [aryeh] like-the-ox [ka-baqar] will-eat [yokhel] straw [teven], and-the-serpent [nachash] — dust [afar] [will be] his-food [lachmo]. They-will-not harm [lo yare'u] and-will-not destroy [lo yashchitu] in-all my-holy mountain [har qodshi]," says YHWH.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.17 — "new heavens and a new earth":** The most expansive eschatological vision in the Hebrew Bible. Not reformation but re-creation — so radical that the former reality is not even remembered. Revelation 21:1 quotes this passage directly.

**v.25 — The peaceable kingdom revisited:** Isaiah 11:6-9 is echoed here — wolf and lamb together, lion eating straw. But now it is set in the context of new creation. The original creation's violence is resolved not by human effort but by divine re-making.

*— EMET*
